completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve absorbing UP TO100 LEVELS OF SPELLS and GAINING RESONANCE POINTS; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define recipient,finite ward duration/concentration,eligible incoming spell event,absorption timing and the relationship between source level,native rank and the100-unit capacity. Specify whole/partial absorption when remaining capacity is insufficient,cantrips,areas,multi-hit/ongoing spells and any choice/Reaction required. Set a concrete RP conversion amount and recovery cap with real payer/recipient history,including allied/self casts,echoes,free casts and multiple shields. Preserve the substantial100-level promise while preventing repeated credit from one spell event or an unbounded mutually profitable recharge loop. Absorption,damage prevention and countering are distinct unless expressly linked.

sourceRecord.completeHistoricalCommonQuestionUnchange: For every selected spell, settle all operational fields: actual activation and components, legal target/range/geometry, duration and concentration, resolution/DC/save or attack, full effect clauses, scaling, repeat casting/source identity, suppression/ending, limits and class-specific rank/cost access. sourceRecord.completeHistoricalScopeExceptionUnchange: Post-push receipts are preserved only, excluded from current mechanical authoring. Existing faction/alignment/location records do not authorize new cosmology, theology or lore.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: Absorb up to 100 levels of spells, gaining RP; Action/120ft/V,S,F/base21. Instantaneous source metadata remains evidence; the ongoing ward below is a NEW completion.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_application: One willing actual living creature with a real RP pool, including self; concentration up to60seconds. Create100 remaining level-units. Automatic, no save and no Reaction to absorb; willingness to this mandatory ward is fixed at application. No physical armor/AC/cover or general antimagic.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_interception: After all actual cast counters and the accepted Mirror one-return protocol, before the first unresolved direct recipient payload rolls an attack/save, automatically intercept that current warded recipient branch. Eligible: a real ordinary/class/ancestry/item spell with defined generating rank0..9, hostile/beneficial/self/allied, direct sole/multiple recipient or an instantaneous area pulse actually reaching this creature. Suppress all initial recipient payload components and attachment of its ongoing child to this recipient. Other recipients/field origins remain. A field established on a point, ongoing tick, pure transfer, reflected damage event, environmental magic or nonspell is not a fresh initial recipient spell branch. An accepted Mirror acts first; a returned original remains the same root. A countered spell reaches no ward. A consumed branch does not run its damage-prevention/save/on-hit hooks.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_capacity: Debit generating rank, with rank0 debiting1unit but recovering0RP. Never use paidRP/characterlevel as rank. Require enough remaining units for the whole branch; insufficient means no debit/no interception/no recovery. One interception per original cast-root and recipient identity across all these Shields, including redirects/copies that retain that root. Multi-hit initial payload to one recipient is intercepted once in full, not per die/missile. Record the root-recipient key before effect suppression. At0 end the ward. A newly paid ward has100 but cannot re-intercept a previously consumed root-recipient.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_recovery: NEW shield-local actual-paid funding: initial root budget=floor(actual ordinary BASE RP truly paid for that spell root /2), excluding surcharges, protected principal, HP, uses, charges and unpaid/waived prices. Preserve actual source price replacements (class Arcane Bolt base1). Award entitlement=min(generating rank, remaining root funding budget) to ward recipient; debit that root budget once before clipping/Nullification. Rank0 awards0. Distinct eligible recipients compete in stable recipientID order for the single root budget. Multiple shields do not duplicate it. Free/waived or charge-only casts can be absorbed but fund0. A copy uses only its real independently permitted new payment, never the old original payment; an exact no-resource descendant cannot fund recovery. Recovery is after interception and prevention of this branch, not countering or healing, and cannot refund its payer. A blocked/dead/full recipient wastes entitlement; no queue. Self/allied casts are legal but at most half actual base returns globally, preventing mutual net profitable recycling through this spell alone.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_priority: Accepted cast counters first; Mirrors return once under their exact source; this Shield then sees the remaining initial actual recipient. If not intercepted, real spell immunities/save/attack then ordinary mitigation/prevention/transfer/temp/form/HP follow their own timing. No global change to Mirror, Barrier or other wards.
